newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - October 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - October 10.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Thursday, the island's National Day. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - President Lee Teng-hui urges mainland China to step up dialogue and communication and promote cooperation with Taiwan in his National Day address.
Council of Agriculture to crack down on illegal tree-cutting.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Taipei construction firm owner shot dead by gangsters.
Education reform committee suggests primary school students should learn standardised romanisation.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Police authorities to investigate illegal stock trading.
Finance Minister to report to President Lee Teng-hui next week on new "two-into-one" tax merger.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Government agencies to implement five-day work week every other week by end-June 1997.
